title: Take one epidemic state step
hook: Two stated cases: explore the transmission term in a normalized SIR update.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the transmission term in a normalized SIR update affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines NextI, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the transmission term in a normalized SIR update in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A normalized toy SIR population has susceptible S 0.99, infected I 0.01, Beta 0.4, Gamma 0.1. Take one Euler step DT 0.1. What next infected share results?

claims.text: New infections and recoveries change the infected stock in opposite directions. A single small deterministic step is not an epidemic forecast. This comparison isolates the transmission term in a normalized SIR update.
